mechanism: Sumatriptan causes vasoconstriction while candesartan causes vasodilation, creating opposing hemodynamic effects; additionally, both may increase blood pressure through different pathways, increasing risk of hypertensive crisis.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely when combining these agents; sumatriptan use should be reserved for migraine treatment when benefits outweigh risks in patients on candesartan, and alternative migraine therapies may be considered.
